subject: Exec QBR & technical demo — sponsor alignment and calendar coordination
messages:
From: Daniel Ortiz <dan.ortiz@bluehorizon.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@bluehorizon.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluehorizon.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec QBR + technical demo — aiming for Oct 19-22

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We'd like to lock in an executive QBR with Redwood (VP/CTO level) and a separate technical deep-dive for engineering/security/procurement. High level ask below: 

- Exec QBR: 60 minutes (VP/Product + CTO + account team) — goal: exec alignment on roadmap, KPIs, and renewal posture.
- Technical deep-dive: 45–60 minutes with Eng and Security (design, data handling, SOC2/retention, inference SLAs).

Preferred windows: Oct 19–20 (mornings PT) or Oct 22 (afternoons PT). Our procurement/legal will likely want to review contract language — can you include your procurement point and a draft MSA/PO template if available?

Attendees we expect: Daniel Ortiz (VP Product), Elena Park (CTO), Samantha Lee (Head of Procurement). I will loop in Legal/Engineering once we have candidate times.

Can you propose 2–3 slots and confirm who from Redwood will present the SOC2/security overview?

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
VP Product, BlueHorizon Analytics

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Ortiz <dan.ortiz@bluehorizon.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aiming for Oct 19-22

Hi Daniel — great to hear from you and thanks for outlining the asks. Happy to coordinate. Proposed slots below (all PT):

1) Exec QBR — Thu Oct 21, 11:00–12:00
2) Exec QBR — Mon Oct 18, 10:30–11:30

For the technical deep-dive we can do the same day immediately after, or a separate session:
- Tech deep-dive — Thu Oct 21, 12:15–13:00 (45 min) or Tue Oct 22, 11:15–12:00

Marcus (SE) will lead the technical demo and Mina (Security) will cover SOC2/retention briefly — copying Marcus and Lauren to coordinate agenda and pre-demo checklist. Sean on this thread in case we need to escalate calendar capacity / exec availability. 

I've attached a short pre-demo-checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf) we ask customers to fill out — it helps Marcus target the demo to your infra and data flows. Also, do you have an internal exec sponsor who will intro the QBR? That helps set the tone.

If you can confirm preferred slot and sponsor, we'll send calendar invites and a draft agenda.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluehorizon.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Daniel Ortiz <dan.ortiz@bluehorizon.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@bluehorizon.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aiming for Oct 19-22

Thanks Ava — quick update from procurement/legal side. Our budget review shifted and we need the procurement team and legal sign-off looped in before an exec-level commitment. Would it be possible to move the QBR to the week of Oct 22? Prefer Oct 22 morning PT if that works.

I've attached our PO template (PO_template.xlsx) and a short list of redline items Legal will check. If Redwood can send an MSA or pointer to the DocuSign draft, that would speed things up.

Proposed: Exec QBR — Fri Oct 22, 10:00–11:00 PT; Tech deep-dive — Fri Oct 22, 11:15–12:00 PT. Please confirm Redwood attendees for the security/ops portion (we need a short SOC2 overview).

Samantha Lee
Head of Procurement, BlueHorizon Analytics

Attachment: PO_template.xlsx

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluehorizon.com>, Daniel Ortiz <dan.ortiz@bluehorizon.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec QBR + technical demo — aiming for Oct 19-22

Thanks Samantha — we can absolutely move to Fri Oct 22. Confirming proposed schedule (all PT):

- Exec QBR: Fri Oct 22, 10:00–11:00 (Daniel / Elena + Redwood exec/AE)
- Tech deep-dive: Fri Oct 22, 11:15–12:00 (Marcus + Eng/Security)

Mina (cc'd) will handle the SOC2/security overview and can prepare a 10–12 slide summary focused on evidence/scope and retention policies. Marcus will tailor the technical demo and would appreciate the completed pre-demo-checklist. Lauren will send calendar invites once you confirm attendees.

I've attached a draft QBR agenda (QBR_agenda_draft.docx) and a short SOC2 summary (SOC2_summary.pdf). For contracts: we have an MSA draft and a DocuSign flow — sending the DocuSign link in case Legal wants to preview (see related links).

Next steps: 
- Daniel/Elena: confirm exec sponsor and any additional attendees by Tue Oct 12.
- Samantha: confirm procurement/legal attendee names for the invite.
- BlueHorizon: return the pre-demo-checklist when convenient.

We'll hold the slots tentatively and send invites after your confirmation.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Ava Chen
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR_agenda_draft.docx; SOC2_summary.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/RH-2026-BH-349; https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/MSA_RH-BH-349

Ava — confirmed.

We will take the Fri Oct 22 times: Exec QBR 10:00–11:00 PT, Technical deep-dive 11:15–12:00 PT. Confirmed attendees from BlueHorizon: myself (Daniel Ortiz, VP Product), Elena Park (CTO), Samantha Lee (Head of Procurement), Chris Morales (Legal).

Please include Mina for the SOC2 overview and Marcus for the demo. Once you send calendar invites and the draft agenda we'll distribute internally and share any follow-up questions.

Thanks,
Daniel Ortiz
VP Product, BlueHorizon Analytics
